name: 5 Persons Infrared Sauna
description: Infrared Sauna stands out with its elegant style. Gorgeous but tough, eco-friendly Canadian Cedar wood of a top quality ensures its durability and capability to withstand any weather and outdoor conditions. A gem amongst its line with just enough cabin space to accommodate three people, whilst to offer a comfort and truly relaxing experience. Among its other features this sauna is fully convertible to an indoor unit (ask us about the details).
